name: The Fate of Zephras
summary: You carry news of the danger facing Zephras to Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar. The fallen wards leave the isle exposed to Al'Akir, and the people of Zephras must decide how to protect their home.

sections.title: A warning for Talaanis
sections.body: You tell Talaanis what happened above the Shrine of Akir and share Elaadrin's plan to leave Zephras Isle. High Elder Shadowsong needs to understand the danger and the purpose of your mission to Azeroth as the people of Zephras seek a way to save their home.

sections.title: What remains
sections.body: Talaanis reflects on the news. Lorthuna is gone, and the cult has lost its leader. Zephras has not been invaded, though Al'Akir may turn his attention to the isle in years or decades. Fear and cause for celebration now stand side by side.

faq.answer: You speak with Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.
You tell Talaanis what happened above the Shrine of Akir and of Elaadrin's plan to leave Zephras Isle.

faq.q: Why are the people of Zephras afraid of Al'Akir?
faq.answer: The wards that hid Zephras are down, and Al'Akir may choose to attack while the people are in his domain.

faq.q: What does High Elder Shadowsong need to know?
faq.answer: He needs to know of the danger and what the people of Zephras intend to do on their mission to Azeroth.
